document.about: Eppendorf Multipette E3/E3x performance data sheet (2 pages). Each item of its Applications list sets one abbreviation bold, Dispensing (Dis). Only the bold face declares a weight, and the bold face's digits and signs come from a face that declares none (E3/E3x).

notes: 2026-11-24 (#122): a line ending in a web address, a domain, an e-mail address or a phone number was a heading when set bold or large.

As above, for an item on one line.
